text.tspan: Agent roles, tools, and scientiﬁc responsibility
Each component owns a scientiﬁc decision and produces reviewable evidence.
Redesign an existing enzyme or generate
a scaﬀold? Which motif or positions?
How should outcomes revise the next round?
The model chooses scientiﬁc actions; tools execute them and return inspectable results.
Current component interfaces are implemented. The full prospective experimental learning loop is proposed work.
